name: olio.cb.book
label: ChapBook
description: A poetry ChapBook: a PictureBook 2 variant where each scene page shows a stanza of poetry overlaid on a landscape image. Inherits all olio.pb.book fields (including maxLinesPerPage, overlayOpacity) and its constraints (slug/organizationId; name/groupId/organizationId) plus ChapBook-specific layout controls.
